Theorem
[Invariance of dimension] ↗ prop:good-pairs-absolute-homology 1. ch2:2.26\group Singular Homology

If nonempty open subsets $U\subset \mathbb {R}^m$ and $V\subset \mathbb {R}^n$ are homeomorphic, then $m=n$.
Proof

\sketch For $x\in U$, excision and the long exact sequence give

\[ H_k(U,U-\{ x\} )\cong H_k(\mathbb {R}^m,\mathbb {R}^m-\{ x\} ) \cong \widetilde H_{k-1}(S^{m-1}), \]

which is nonzero exactly when $k=m$. A homeomorphism identifies these local homology groups with those of $(V,V-\{ h(x)\} )$, which are nonzero exactly in degree $n$; hence $m=n$.

□
